summary: 你平日和緩、不爭先，但遇到不公或有人有難，就會站出來。
watch: 要留意的是：你平日不爭，一出面就扛得多，而且不太開口求助。
life: 平日在團隊裡你隨和好相處，很少搶位置；可是看見有人受委屈、事情不合理，你會第一個開口，事後還替人收拾。

en.summary: You're easy-going and don't push to the front, but when something is unfair or someone is in trouble, you step up.
en.watch: The catch: you rarely compete, yet once you step in you carry a lot, and you seldom ask for help.
en.life: On a team you're easy to get along with and rarely jostle for position; but when someone is treated badly or something doesn't add up, you're the first to speak, and you help clean up afterwards.

summary: 你待人和緩不爭，心裡卻不接受表面說法，事情要問清楚才安心。
watch: 要留意的是：你想舒服過日子，對含糊的事卻放不下，兩股力常在拉扯。
life: 你平日隨和，一頓好飯就滿足；但遇到說不清的條款或交代，你會追問到明白為止，別人才發現你沒那麼好打發。

en.summary: You're mild and don't compete, yet you don't accept surface explanations; you're only at ease once things are clear.
en.watch: The catch: you want an easy life but can't let vague things go, and the two pull against each other.
en.life: You're relaxed day to day, happy with a good meal; but faced with unclear terms or explanations, you'll keep asking until you understand, and people find you're not so easily brushed off.

summary: 你一面向外照顧場面，一面往內收，心裡自有分寸。
watch: 要留意的是：你在人前撐場面，心裡的事卻收著，兩邊的落差別人不容易看見。
life: 聚會上你會主動招呼、讓別人過得去；回到家卻要一段安靜的時間，把當天記下的感受慢慢放下。

en.summary: You look outward and look after the room, yet you also draw inward and keep your own measure of things.
en.watch: The catch: you hold things together in front of people while keeping your own feelings in, and others rarely see the gap.
en.life: At a gathering you're the one who welcomes people and smooths things over; back home you need quiet time to set down what you noticed and felt that day.

summary: 你對看重的事放得很深，但出手前會先把底盤做穩，不輕易冒進。
watch: 要留意的是：你心裡的強度和表面的穩重不一樣，別人常低估你有多在意。
life: 認定的目標你會一直放在心上，卻不會貿然押上全部；先把錢、時間和後路安排好，才一步步投入。

en.summary: You throw yourself into what matters to you, but before you move you make sure the ground is solid, and you don't rush in.
en.watch: The catch: the intensity inside you doesn't match your steady surface, so people often underestimate how much you care.
en.life: You keep a chosen goal in mind for a long time, but you won't stake everything at once; you arrange the money, time and fallback first, then commit step by step.

summary: 你做事講原則、投入深，表面上又力求妥當，不留話柄。
watch: 要留意的是：你想守住原則，又想各方都過得去，兩者衝突時最耗你。
life: 工作上你會把程序做足、讓每個人都交代得過去；但碰到你在意的是非，你很難只為場面好看就讓步。

en.summary: You hold to principle and commit deeply, while on the surface you take care to keep things proper and leave nothing to criticise.
en.watch: The catch: you want to keep your principles and keep everyone satisfied, and when the two clash, it wears you down most.
en.life: At work you follow procedure fully so everyone is covered; but on a question of right and wrong that you care about, you find it hard to give way just to keep things looking smooth.

summary: 你想到就想做，但會先確認底盤穩妥，才真正出手。
watch: 要留意的是：你心急和謹慎同時存在，常在「現在做」和「再等等」之間拉扯。
life: 計劃一定下，你就想立刻動手，可是動手前又會把預算和風險算清楚；別人看你果斷，你自己知道每一步都掂量過。

en.summary: Once you think of something you want to act, but you check that the ground is secure before you really move.
en.watch: The catch: impatience and caution live side by side in you, and you're often torn between "now" and "wait a little".
en.life: Once a plan is set you want to start straight away, yet first you work out the budget and the risks; others see you as decisive, but you know every step was weighed.

summary: 你做事直接、要結果，同時重視程序妥當，不想留下話柄。
watch: 要留意的是：你求快又求妥當，急起來時容易把身邊的人和細節壓過去。
life: 你接手一件事，會先把規矩和分工定清楚，然後直接推進；只是推得急時，記得停一停，問問跟著你的人跟不跟得上。

en.summary: You're direct and want results, and you also care about doing things properly so there's nothing to criticise.
en.watch: The catch: you want speed and propriety at once, and when you're in a hurry, people and details around you can get flattened.
en.life: When you take something on, you first set the rules and the division of work, then push ahead; when you're pushing hard, pause and check whether the people following you can keep up.

summary: 你和朋友相處不爭不計較，但一開口往往說得很準，不一定好聽。
watch: 要留意的是：你平時不出聲，說出來的卻很直，朋友容易覺得突然。
life: 朋友聚會你多半說「都可以」，很少計較；可是朋友問你意見時，你會直說問題在哪裡，先說一句體諒的話，對方更聽得進去。

en.summary: With friends you don't compete or keep score, but when you do speak, you're often spot on, and not always gentle.
en.watch: The catch: you're usually quiet, so when you speak bluntly, friends can feel it comes out of nowhere.
en.life: At get-togethers you usually say "anything's fine" and rarely keep score; but when a friend asks your view, you say plainly where the problem is, and starting with a word of understanding helps them take it in.

summary: 你在朋友之間常居中傳話，但看到問題時，你會直接點出來。
watch: 要留意的是：你既想把兩邊接上，又忍不住說準話，有時兩邊都不討好。
life: 朋友有矛盾時常找你訴苦，你聽得多，也看得清誰有問題；說出口之前想一想時機，你的調停才不會變成另一場爭論。

en.summary: Among friends you often carry messages between people, but when you see a problem, you name it directly.
en.watch: The catch: you want to connect both sides yet can't help saying the accurate thing, and sometimes neither side thanks you.
en.life: When friends fall out they often come to you; you hear a lot and see clearly who's at fault, so think about timing before you speak, or your peacemaking can turn into another argument.

summary: 你對朋友有自己的標準，但說出口時，會顧及場面不讓人難看。
watch: 要留意的是：你心裡的要求和表面的和氣不一致，朋友未必知道你介意甚麼。
life: 一起做事的朋友遲到、交得不好，你心裡有數，表面卻先把場面圓好；真正介意的事，私下直接說一次比一直忍著好。

en.summary: You hold friends to your own standards, but when you speak up you take care not to embarrass anyone.
en.watch: The catch: what you expect inside and the calm you show don't match, so friends may not know what bothers you.
en.life: When a friend you work with is late or delivers poorly, you notice, but you smooth things over first; for what really bothers you, saying it once in private beats putting up with it.

summary: 你在感情裡求安穩、願意遷就，但心裡的疑問總要講清楚才放下。
watch: 要留意的是：你一時說算了，一時又追問到底，對方會摸不準你真正在意甚麼。
life: 小事你多半說「算了」，可是某件事一直沒講清楚，你會在某一天一次過問出來；與其積著，不如在當下輕輕問一句。

en.summary: In love you look for steadiness and are willing to give way, but a question in your mind has to be cleared up before you can let it go.
en.watch: The catch: one moment you say "never mind", the next you're asking to the bottom of it, and your partner can't tell what you really care about.
en.life: On small things you usually say "never mind", but if something stays unclear, one day you'll ask about it all at once; rather than letting it build up, ask gently at the time.

summary: 你在感情裡用照顧表達心意，遇到含糊的事又一定要問清楚。
watch: 要留意的是：你照顧得多卻少講自己，開口時又多是追問，對方只聽到質疑。
life: 你會替伴侶安排好大小事，卻很少說自己想要甚麼；真要談時，先說「我在意」，再問清楚，比直接追問好得多。

en.summary: In love you show you care by looking after your partner, and when something is vague you have to get it clear.
en.watch: The catch: you look after them a lot but say little about yourself, and when you do speak it's mostly questions, so they hear only doubt.
en.life: You arrange things big and small for your partner but rarely say what you want; when you do talk, start with "this matters to me" before asking, which works far better than questioning straight away.

summary: 你在感情裡投入很深、要求也高，卻很少把心裡的話說出口。
watch: 要留意的是：你預設對方應該懂你的在意，落差出現時，對方往往還不知道發生了甚麼。
life: 你會默默為伴侶扛下很多，也很在意對方的回應；訊息回得慢、答應的事忘了，與其放在心裡，不如直接說給對方聽。

en.summary: In love you commit deeply and expect a lot, yet you rarely say what's on your mind.
en.watch: The catch: you assume your partner should understand how much you care, so when there's a gap, they often don't know anything has happened.
en.life: You quietly carry a lot for your partner and care a great deal how they respond; when replies are slow or promises forgotten, say so directly instead of keeping it inside.

summary: 你在感情裡投入很深，同時想用穩定守住這段關係。
watch: 要留意的是：你的要求很高，卻習慣把不滿壓下來維持平穩，壓久了反而更重。
life: 你會記得伴侶的習慣、把日子安排妥當，也很在意對方是否同樣上心；介意的地方早一點說，比一直維持表面平穩更好。

en.summary: In love you commit deeply, and you want to protect the relationship by keeping it steady.
en.watch: The catch: you expect a lot, yet you tend to push dissatisfaction down to keep the peace, and held too long it only gets heavier.
en.life: You remember your partner's habits and keep daily life in order, and you care whether they're just as attentive; saying what bothers you early is better than keeping up a calm surface.

summary: 你在感情裡用行動表達在意，遇到僵局寧願推倒重談。
watch: 要留意的是：你少談感受，卻一出手就很強烈，對方感到的多是衝擊而不是理解。
life: 伴侶不開心時，你先想辦法解決；問題拖久了，你會想一次攤開、整個重來；放慢一點，先坐下來聽對方說，比一次解決更重要。

en.summary: In love you show you care through action, and at a deadlock you'd rather tear it down and start the conversation over.
en.watch: The catch: you talk little about feelings, but when you act it's forceful, and your partner feels the impact more than the understanding.
en.life: When your partner is unhappy, you look for a fix first; if a problem drags on, you want to lay it all out and start again; slowing down to sit and listen first matters more than solving it in one go.

summary: 你帶後輩投入很深，有自己的原則，卻也樂見對方走出自己的路。
watch: 要留意的是：你的要求和放手同時存在，對方未必分得清哪些必須做到。
life: 你會把自己認為重要的原則教給孩子或後輩，也鼓勵對方另闢蹊徑；先說清楚哪幾條是底線，其他放手，對方會更安心。

en.summary: With younger people you invest deeply and have your own principles, yet you're glad to see them find their own way.
en.watch: The catch: your demands and your letting go exist side by side, and they may not be able to tell which things are non-negotiable.
en.life: You pass on the principles you think matter to children or younger people, and you also encourage them to strike out on their own; say clearly which few lines are firm and let the rest go, and they'll feel more secure.

summary: 你帶後輩投入很深，也喜歡帶對方嘗試新東西。
watch: 要留意的是：你一時要求到位，一時又興趣轉了，對方容易跟不上你的節奏。
life: 你會帶孩子或後輩去試新的興趣，也會認真要求對方做好；開了頭的事陪對方走完一段，比不斷開新的更有用。

en.summary: With younger people you invest deeply, and you like to bring them new things to try.
en.watch: The catch: one moment you want things done properly, the next your interest has moved on, and they can struggle to keep pace with you.
en.life: You take children or younger people to try new interests and expect them to do well; staying with something you started for a while is more useful than constantly starting new ones.

summary: 你帶後輩給資源也給標準，同時樂見對方闖出自己的路。
watch: 要留意的是：你不耐等，看到對方走得慢就想接手，這和你給的自由互相抵觸。
life: 你願意給孩子或後輩資源，也樂見對方另闢蹊徑；看到對方做得慢時，先忍一忍別接手，讓對方自己走完一次。

en.summary: With younger people you give resources and standards, and you also encourage them to find their own way.
en.watch: The catch: you're impatient, and when they move slowly you want to take over, which works against the freedom you give.
en.life: You're willing to give children or younger people resources and glad to see them try new paths; when they're slow, hold back from taking over and let them get through it themselves once.

summary: 你帶後輩給資源也給標準，也喜歡帶對方試新的東西。
watch: 要留意的是：你的節奏快、興趣也多，對方可能還沒做好，你已經轉到下一件。
life: 你會帶孩子或後輩去試新的運動、課程，也期待對方跟得上；開了頭的事，給對方多一點時間做完，比再開一樣新的更好。

en.summary: With younger people you give resources and standards, and you like to bring them new things to try.
en.watch: The catch: your pace is quick and your interests many, so before they've finished one thing you may have moved to the next.
en.life: You take children or younger people to try new sports and courses and expect them to keep up; giving them more time to finish what's started is better than opening something new.

summary: 你帶後輩心裡有一套標準，卻也欣賞對方另闢蹊徑。
watch: 要留意的是：你嘴上支持對方另走一條路，對方真的偏離你的標準時，壓力會特別大。
life: 你會給孩子或後輩定下要求，也喜歡看對方有自己的想法；對方想走另一條路時，先聽聽理由，再決定哪些標準真的不能讓。

en.summary: With younger people you carry a set of standards in your head, yet you admire it when they find their own way.
en.watch: The catch: you say you want them to go their own way, but when they really depart from your standards, the pressure you put on is especially heavy.
en.life: You set expectations for children or younger people and like to see them think for themselves; when they want to take another path, hear their reasons first, then decide which standards truly can't give.

summary: 你帶後輩一面給標準，一面把新的嘗試帶給對方。
watch: 要留意的是：你給的嘗試很開放，期待的結果卻有標準，對方會覺得自由有限。
life: 你會帶孩子或後輩接觸新的興趣，也希望對方做得像樣；先說好哪些是玩、哪些要做到，對方會更自在。

en.summary: With younger people you set standards on one hand and bring new things to try on the other.
en.watch: The catch: what you offer to try is wide open, but you expect results to meet a standard, so they may feel the freedom is limited.
en.life: You introduce children or younger people to new interests and hope they'll do them properly; agreeing up front which things are for fun and which need doing well will put them at ease.

summary: 你樂於替別人花錢，自己卻用得樸素，收入偏向穩定的來源。
watch: 要留意的是：你給出去的多，留給自己的少，記得先替自己存一份。
life: 請客、資助家人朋友你很少猶豫，自己的開支卻很節省；收入適合來自穩定的工作，每月先撥一筆存起來，再談給別人。

en.summary: You're happy to spend on others but plain with yourself, and your income leans towards steady sources.
en.watch: Keep in mind that you give out much more than you keep, so remember to save a share for yourself first.
en.life: You rarely hesitate to treat or support family and friends, yet you spend sparingly on yourself; steady work suits your income, so set aside a sum each month before giving to others.

summary: 你一面花錢大方，一面又習慣小額慢慢地積存。
watch: 要留意的是：你給別人時很大方，給自己留的卻要慢慢積，突然的支出最讓你不安。
life: 請客、送禮你不手軟，私底下卻有幾個按月存錢的戶口；把給別人的和留給自己的分開兩個戶口，你會安心得多。

en.summary: You spend generously, and at the same time you're in the habit of saving slowly in small amounts.
en.watch: The catch: you're generous with others while what you keep for yourself builds slowly, and sudden expenses unsettle you most.
en.life: You don't hold back on treating people or giving gifts, yet privately you have a few accounts you pay into monthly; keeping what's for others and what's for you in separate accounts will put your mind at ease.

summary: 你肯為看好的事投下本錢，但會先留下安全邊際。
watch: 要留意的是：你想全力投入，又不想動到底線，最好先把底線定清楚。
life: 認定了一件事，你肯投錢，但會先把一筆應急錢放好不動；投之前寫下最多能投多少，你就能放心去做。

en.summary: You're willing to stake money on what you believe in, but you leave a safety margin first.
en.watch: Keep in mind that you want to go all in without touching your floor, so it's best to fix that floor clearly first.
en.life: Once you're sure about something you'll put money in, but you first set aside an emergency fund you won't touch; write down the most you'll invest beforehand, and you can go ahead with confidence.

summary: 你願意為認定的事投入成本，同時把帳目和條款弄得清清楚楚。
watch: 要留意的是：你的投入感和守規矩的習慣會互相拉扯，難下決定時先看條款。
life: 投資或做生意時，你肯為看好的事出錢，也會把合約、帳目逐條看清；先定好上限和規矩，你出手時會更踏實。

en.summary: You're willing to invest in what you believe in, and you keep the accounts and terms perfectly clear.
en.watch: The catch: your drive to commit and your habit of following the rules pull against each other; when it's hard to decide, read the terms first.
en.life: In investing or business you'll put money into what you rate, and you read contracts and accounts line by line; set your limit and your rules first, and you'll act on firmer ground.

summary: 你對錢主動經營，也重視守住，進取和穩健兼顧。
watch: 要留意的是：你想出手時又想留後路，需要果斷的時機可能慢半拍。
life: 你懂得以錢生錢，也會先存起一份安全的錢；把可以冒險的錢和不能動的錢分開，你做決定會快很多。

en.summary: You manage money actively and also care about holding on to it, balancing drive with caution.
en.watch: The catch: when you want to move you also want a way out, so you may be half a beat slow when a moment calls for decisiveness.
en.life: You know how to make money grow and you put aside a safe share first; separate the money you can risk from the money you can't touch, and your decisions will come much faster.

summary: 你對錢主動經營，同時講秩序，帳目分明、按時付款。
watch: 要留意的是：你願意承擔風險，但規矩和程序會拖慢你出手的時機。
life: 你對數字敏感，投資和做生意都合你的性格；你也會把帳目和條款弄清楚，替自己定一套出手的規矩，比臨場判斷更穩。

en.summary: You manage money actively and value order: clear accounts and payments on time.
en.watch: The catch: you're willing to take risks, but rules and procedure can slow the moment you act.
en.life: You're sharp with numbers, and investing or running a business suits you; you also keep accounts and terms clear, so setting yourself rules for when to act is steadier than judging on the spot.

summary: 你在新環境討人喜歡，但要先安頓好，才真正展開。
watch: 要留意的是：別人以為你已經融入，你其實還在安頓，頻繁搬動對你特別累。
life: 到了新地方，身邊很快有人願意幫你；你會先找好住處、摸清附近的生活，才開始工作和社交，給自己這段時間很重要。

en.summary: In a new place people warm to you, but you need to settle in before you really get going.
en.watch: The catch: others think you've already fitted in while you're still settling, so frequent moves are especially tiring for you.
en.life: In a new place, people soon offer to help; you first find somewhere to live and learn the neighbourhood before starting on work and socialising, and giving yourself that time matters.

summary: 你在新環境態度隨和，但要建立信任，仍需要一段時間。
watch: 要留意的是：你說話直的時候，新認識的人會一時誤會你，相處久了評價才會反過來。
life: 你到了外地，起初別人覺得你好相處；熟一點後你說話直，有人會不習慣，給對方時間認識你，信任會慢慢建立。

en.summary: In a new place your manner is easy-going, but building trust still takes a while.
en.watch: The catch: when you speak bluntly, people who've just met you may misread you for a time, and only later does their view turn around.
en.life: Somewhere new, people at first find you easy to get along with; once you're more familiar and speak bluntly, some take time to adjust, so give them time to know you and trust will build.

summary: 你在新環境適應得快，但心裡仍要先安頓好，才算真正開始。
watch: 要留意的是：你搬得動也適應得了，只是每次重新安頓都在耗你的力氣。
life: 你適合到外地讀書或工作，新規矩很快摸得清；到埗後先把住處和生活節奏安頓好，再全力展開，會比一到就衝更順。

en.summary: You adapt quickly to new places, but inside you still need to settle before you've truly begun.
en.watch: The catch: you can move and you can adapt, but each time you settle again it costs you energy.
en.life: Studying or working away suits you, and you soon get the hang of new rules; once you arrive, sort out where you live and your daily rhythm first, then go all out, and it'll go more smoothly than charging in.

summary: 你在新環境摸規矩很快，但要讓人信任你，需要多一點時間。
watch: 要留意的是：你的難處不在適應，而在前段說話容易帶刺，別人要認識你之後才改觀。
life: 你到了新公司或新城市，很快就摸清規矩和人事；剛認識的人可能覺得你說話直，相處一段時間後，信任會慢慢建立。

en.summary: In a new place you work out the rules fast, but it takes longer for people to trust you.
en.watch: The catch: your difficulty isn't adapting; it's that early on your words can sound sharp, and people only change their view once they know you.
en.life: At a new company or in a new city, you soon understand the rules and the people; those who've just met you may find you blunt, but after a while trust builds.

summary: 你在外面放得開，但每到一處，仍要先把生活安頓好。
watch: 要留意的是：你在外表現自在，內裡安頓得慢，頻繁變動的代價比你以為的大。
life: 你到外地進修或工作，很快就能和人打成一片；同時你會先找好住處、建立熟悉的生活點，才覺得真正落腳。

en.summary: Away from home you open up, but wherever you go you still need to settle your daily life first.
en.watch: The catch: you look at ease out in the world while settling slowly inside, so frequent change costs more than you think.
en.life: Studying or working somewhere new, you soon get on with people; at the same time you find a place to live and a few familiar spots before you feel you've really landed.

summary: 你在外面比在家自在，但說話直，要建立信任需要時間。
watch: 要留意的是：你在人前很放得開，新認識的人卻可能覺得你的話帶刺。
life: 你適合到外地交流、累積資歷，靠表達打開局面；剛認識的人可能覺得你說話直，相處一段時間後，評價往往會反過來。

en.summary: You're more at ease away from home, but you speak bluntly, so building trust takes time.
en.watch: The catch: you're open in front of people, yet those who've just met you may find your words sharp.
en.life: Exchanges and building experience away from home suit you, and you open doors by speaking well; people new to you may find you blunt, but after a while their view often turns around.

summary: 你在外面比在家放得開，但適應新環境的方式是先觀察、再出手。
watch: 要留意的是：你往往要過一陣子才發揮得出來，短期的場合對你較吃虧。
life: 你離開熟悉的地方，往往能擺脫舊有的人情包袱；長期外派或移居比短期出差更適合你，給自己一段時間觀察，才會越來越自在。

en.summary: You open up more away from home, but your way of adapting is to watch first and act later.
en.watch: The catch: you usually show what you can do only after a while, so short stays work against you.
en.life: Leaving familiar places often frees you from old obligations; long postings or moving abroad suit you better than short trips, and giving yourself time to observe lets you grow more at ease.

summary: 你在外面比在家放得開，進退也有分寸，讓人願意給你機會。
watch: 要留意的是：你在新環境需要先摸清規矩，才找得到自己的位置。
life: 你離開熟悉的地方發展，往往更放得開，也容易得到前輩賞識；先把新地方的規矩熟悉好，你的分寸會替你打開門。

en.summary: You open up more away from home, and your sense of proportion makes people willing to give you a chance.
en.watch: Keep in mind that in a new place you need to learn the rules before you can find your footing.
en.life: Building a life away from familiar places, you often open up more and win the regard of seniors; get to know the local rules first, and your sense of proportion will open doors for you.

summary: 你在外面有事要做時進入狀態很快，但適應環境本身，你偏向先觀察。
watch: 要留意的是：工作上你很快上手，生活和人際的安頓卻需要較長時間。
life: 每次出差或外派，你很快就忙起來、把事情推進；生活上的安頓則慢一點，長期派駐比短期往返更適合你。

en.summary: Away from home, with something to get done you're in gear fast, but in adapting to the place itself you tend to watch first.
en.watch: The catch: at work you pick things up quickly, but settling your life and relationships takes longer.
en.life: On every trip or posting you get busy fast and move things forward; settling into daily life is slower, so long postings suit you better than short back-and-forth trips.

summary: 你在外面有事可做時最能發揮，進退也得體，讓人願意給你機會。
watch: 要留意的是：沒有既有規矩可依時，你需要多一點時間找到自己的位置。
life: 你到了新城市或新公司，很快就忙起來、有新的項目和目標；先熟悉那裡的規矩和前輩，你會更快站穩。

en.summary: Away from home you do best with something to do, and your sense of proportion makes people willing to give you a chance.
en.watch: Keep in mind that with no existing rules to go by, you need a bit more time to find your footing.
en.life: In a new city or company you soon get busy with new projects and goals; get to know the local rules and the senior people first, and you'll find your feet faster.

summary: 你在外面開局快、果斷，但有人同行或引介時，你會更順。
watch: 要留意的是：你習慣自己硬闖，卻不擅長開口求助，孤身時容易吃力。
life: 出差、外派或到新公司，你很快就能開局；有熟人引介時事情更順，一個人去陌生地方時，先主動認識一兩個可以問事的人。

en.summary: Away from home you get things started quickly and decisively, but with a companion or an introduction it goes more smoothly.
en.watch: The catch: you're used to forcing your way through on your own but not good at asking for help, so alone it can be hard going.
en.life: On trips, postings or at a new company you get going fast; an introduction from someone you know makes it smoother, and when you go somewhere unfamiliar alone, make a point of getting to know one or two people you can ask.

summary: 你在外面開得出新局面，但有人同行或引介時，會走得更順。
watch: 要留意的是：你不怕換地方，在陌生場合卻不太開口求助。
life: 你到外地發展，敢於重新開始；有前輩或熟人引介時更容易站穩，一個人出發前，先替自己找一兩個能問事的人。

en.summary: Away from home you can open up new ground, but with a companion or introduction it goes more smoothly.
en.watch: The catch: moving costs you little emotionally, yet among strangers you rarely ask for help.
en.life: Building a life elsewhere, you dare to start over; with an introduction from a senior or someone you know you find your feet more easily, so before setting out alone, line up one or two people you can ask.

summary: 你出了門比在家更有活力，有人同行或引介時，表現更好。
watch: 要留意的是：熱鬧的場合你放得開，真要一個人在陌生地方找幫手，你卻不太開口。
life: 出差、旅行時你很吃得開，飯局和新朋友都多；有熟人引介時事情最順，一個人到陌生地方，先主動認識一兩個可以問事的人。

en.summary: You're livelier away from home, and you do better with a companion or an introduction.
en.watch: The catch: you're at ease in lively company, but when you need help alone in an unfamiliar place, you don't easily ask.
en.life: On trips and travel you get on well, with plenty of dinners and new friends; things go best with an introduction, and alone somewhere unfamiliar, make a point of getting to know one or two people you can ask.

summary: 你在群體裡隨和好相處，但遇到不公的事，你會出面主持公道。
watch: 要留意的是：你為別人出面時很有分量，替自己爭取時卻很少開口。
life: 你和同事、朋友相處融洽，平時很少計較；有人受委屈時你會站出來說話，分工和分配資源時，也記得替自己說一句。

en.summary: In a group you're easy to get along with, but when something is unfair, you step in to see justice done.
en.watch: The catch: you carry weight when you speak up for others, yet you rarely speak up for yourself.
en.life: You get on well with colleagues and friends and seldom keep score; when someone is treated unfairly you speak up, so when work and resources are shared out, remember to say a word for yourself too.

summary: 你在群體裡脾氣好、肯配合，但看見漏洞時會直接指出來。
watch: 要留意的是：你平時不表態，一開口就是指出問題，別人一時會覺得難搞。
life: 你和同事相處隨和，很少爭位置；開會時看到問題，你會說出來，找對時機說，你的意見會更受歡迎。

en.summary: In a group you're good-natured and cooperative, but when you see a flaw you point it out directly.
en.watch: The catch: you usually don't take sides, so when you speak up it's to point out a problem, and people may find you difficult for a while.
en.life: You're relaxed with colleagues and rarely compete for position; when you spot a problem in a meeting you say so, and choosing the right moment will make your view more welcome.

summary: 你在群體裡立場清楚，同時懂得協調，讓事情運作下去。
watch: 要留意的是：你心裡分得很清楚，表面卻在居中協調，兩者衝突時你最累。
life: 你交遊廣，認同你的人會很快靠攏；工作上你也會居中協調、把流程接上，只是遇到立場相反的人，偶爾留一點中間地帶。

en.summary: In a group your position is clear, and you also know how to coordinate and keep things running.
en.watch: The catch: inside you draw clear lines while outwardly you mediate, and when the two clash it tires you most.
en.life: You know a lot of people, and those who agree with you soon gather round; at work you also mediate and link up the process, but with people on the other side, leave a little middle ground now and then.

summary: 你做事擅長變通找路，但底線是守規矩、分清是非。
watch: 要留意的是：你想靈活應變，又要守住原則，兩者衝突時你會在心裡反覆權衡。
life: 你適合需要應變又講原則的工作，例如策劃、顧問、審核、教學；在規矩之內找新做法，最能發揮你的長處。

en.summary: At work you're good at adapting and finding a way through, but your bottom line is keeping to the rules and telling right from wrong.
en.watch: The catch: you want to adapt flexibly and also hold to principle, and when the two clash you weigh it over and over.
en.life: Work that needs both quick thinking and principle suits you, such as planning, consulting, auditing or teaching; finding new ways within the rules brings out your strengths.

summary: 你做事擅長拆解和變通，也能把底層的細節長期打理妥當。
watch: 要留意的是：你想求新求變，又要穩定累積，兩股力會拉扯你的耐性。
life: 你適合規劃、分析、策劃一類的工作，既要想新方案，也要把資料和細節弄清楚；給自己一個穩定的崗位，在裡面找變化。

en.summary: At work you're good at breaking things down and adapting, and you can also keep the underlying details in order over the long run.
en.watch: The catch: you want novelty and change, and also steady accumulation, and the two strain your patience.
en.life: Planning, analysis and strategy suit you, where you both think up new approaches and get the data and details straight; give yourself a stable role and find variety within it.

summary: 你做事喜歡站到前面，也講原則，適合需要出面又要把關的位置。
watch: 要留意的是：你推得動事情，也容易把把關的責任都攬上身。
life: 你適合對外又講原則的工作，例如教學、公共服務、專業顧問；站到人前推動事情時，也要把收尾的責任分出去。

en.summary: At work you like to be out in front and you hold to principle, which suits roles that need both a public face and a gatekeeper.
en.watch: The catch: you can get things moving, and you also tend to take all the gatekeeping on yourself.
en.life: Outward-facing work with principles suits you, such as teaching, public service or professional advice; when you lead things in front of people, share out the responsibility for finishing them too.

summary: 你做事一面站到前面對外，一面也能在背後把底層打理妥當。
watch: 要留意的是：你在台前和幕後之間切換，容易兩邊都攬上身。
life: 你適合既要對外又要細心的工作，例如傳播、教學、規劃；分清哪些場合要站出來、哪些交給自己慢慢做，會省力得多。

en.summary: At work you step out in front on one side and keep the groundwork in order behind the scenes on the other.
en.watch: The catch: you switch between front stage and backstage, and can easily end up carrying both.
en.life: Work that needs both a public face and care suits you, such as communications, teaching or planning; sorting out which occasions need you up front and which you can work through quietly will save you a lot of effort.

summary: 你做事直取目標，但會先把流程和資源安排妥當。
watch: 要留意的是：你想快又要穩，在需要冒險求快的時候，難免顯得保守。
life: 你適合財經、營運、管理一類講結果又講穩妥的工作；接手有基礎的團隊或事業，把它做大做穩，最合你的方式。

en.summary: At work you go straight for the goal, but you first put the process and resources in order.
en.watch: The catch: you want speed and stability, so when a situation calls for risk and haste, you can seem cautious.
en.life: Finance, operations and management, where results and security both count, suit you; taking over an established team or business and making it bigger and steadier fits your way best.

summary: 你做事直取目標，同時依規格執行，把制度用得好。
watch: 要留意的是：你重結果也重程序，需要協調人情時，容易和人碰撞。
life: 你適合財經、營運、行政管理這類講數字也講規矩的工作；目標清楚、責任分明的崗位，最能發揮你的執行力。

en.summary: At work you go straight for the goal and also follow the specifications, making good use of the system.
en.watch: The catch: you care about results and about procedure, and when personal feelings need handling, you can clash with people.
en.life: Finance, operations and administration, where numbers and rules both count, suit you; roles with clear goals and clear responsibility bring out your ability to deliver.

summary: 你自己住哪裡都可以，但會先替家人想清楚住不住得安穩。
watch: 要留意的是：你自己搬得輕鬆，顧及家人時卻要考慮更多，決定往往比你想像的慢。
life: 搬家對你不算甚麼成本，但你會先想長輩上落、孩子上學方不方便；自己喜歡的間隔，反而排到最後。

en.summary: You could live almost anywhere yourself, but you think first about whether your family would be settled there.
en.watch: The catch: moving is easy for you alone, but with the family to consider there's more to weigh, and decisions often take longer than you expect.
en.life: Moving costs you little, but you first think about whether it's easy for older relatives to get about and for children to get to school; the layout you'd like for yourself comes last.

summary: 你搬動不怕麻煩，但每到一處，都要住得安靜、屬於自己。
watch: 要留意的是：你換地方容易，住得不對卻會長期不舒服，搬之前多看幾次。
life: 你搬家、換工作地點的次數可能比別人多；每次選住處，你很在意安靜和私密，在不同時段親身去看一看，比只看照片可靠。

en.summary: Moving doesn't trouble you, but wherever you go you need somewhere quiet that feels your own.
en.watch: The catch: changing places is easy for you, but living in the wrong one leaves you uneasy for a long time, so look a few times before you move.
en.life: You may move house or change workplace more often than most; each time you choose a home you care about quiet and privacy, so visit at different times of day rather than trusting photos.

summary: 你的家對人開放，安排住處時，也先想家裡每個人住不住得好。
watch: 要留意的是：你的住處常跟著別人的需要調整，自己的喜好很少排在前面。
life: 你的家常有人來往，你也不介意被打擾；搬家時你先想長輩和孩子方不方便，記得也替自己留一個安靜的角落。

en.summary: Your home is open to people, and in arranging where to live, you first think about whether everyone in the family will be comfortable.
en.watch: The catch: your home keeps adjusting to other people's needs, and your own preferences seldom come first.
en.life: People are often in and out of your home, and you don't mind; when you move you think first about older relatives and children, so remember to keep a quiet corner for yourself too.

summary: 你的家既是待客的地方，也要有一個安靜、屬於自己的角落。
watch: 要留意的是：你樂意讓空間被使用，卻也需要私密，兩者沒分好時你會累。
life: 你喜歡在家招呼朋友，也很在意家裡安靜私密；把待客的空間和自己的角落分開，你會住得更舒服。

en.summary: Your home is a place to welcome people, and it also needs a quiet corner that's yours.
en.watch: The catch: you're happy for the space to be used, but you also need privacy, and when the two aren't separated, it wears you out.
en.life: You like having friends over and care a lot about quiet and privacy at home; keeping the space for guests apart from your own corner will make you more comfortable.

summary: 你把住處看成長期基地，而且要合乎自己的規格。
watch: 要留意的是：你不輕易搬，但對格局的要求高，改造的成本往往不小。
life: 你喜歡在一個地方長期住下，搬進去前常想改一改間隔、燈光和擺設；裝修的預算最好先定上限，免得改到一半超支。

en.summary: You see your home as a long-term base, and it has to meet your own standards.
en.watch: The catch: you don't move lightly, but you're demanding about layout, so making changes often costs a fair amount.
en.life: You like to settle in one place for a long time, and before moving in you often want to change the layout, lighting and furnishings; set a ceiling for the renovation budget so you don't overspend halfway.

summary: 你對住處要求合乎自己的規格，也重視手續齊全、不出紕漏。
watch: 要留意的是：你不肯將就，又要樣樣妥當，安頓的成本會比別人高。
life: 你對住處的格局和氛圍很講究，簽約和手續也一一看清；裝修和改動之前先定好預算，比改到一半再補更划算。

en.summary: You need your home to meet your own standards, and you care that the paperwork is complete and nothing goes wrong.
en.watch: The catch: you won't make do, and you want everything in order, so settling in costs you more than most.
en.life: You're particular about layout and atmosphere and go through contracts and paperwork one by one; set the budget before renovating or making changes, which works out better than topping up halfway.

summary: 你對住處要求不多，但真要安頓時，會按自己的標準安排。
watch: 要留意的是：你忙起來可以隨處住，一旦定下來，搬遷的心理成本卻不低。
life: 忙的時候，一張床、一個做事的地方對你就夠；真正要安頓下來時，你會花時間把家佈置成自己認可的樣子。

en.summary: You don't ask much of a home, but when you really settle, you arrange it to your own standards.
en.watch: The catch: when busy you can live anywhere, but once you've settled, moving costs you more than it seems.
en.life: When you're busy, a bed and somewhere to work are enough; when you truly settle, you take time to arrange your home the way you approve of.

summary: 你的住處常在調整，但每一次都要改成自己認可的樣子。
watch: 要留意的是：你又搬又改，對標準又不肯放低，時間和錢都要預先算好。
life: 你搬家、改間隔、換家具的次數比別人多，而且每次都要佈置到合心意；大改動之前，先算一算時間和錢。

en.summary: Your home is often being rearranged, but each time it has to become something you approve of.
en.watch: The catch: you move and remodel and won't lower your standards, so work out the time and money in advance.
en.life: You move house, change layouts and swap furniture more often than most, and each time it has to feel right; before a big change, work out the time and the money.

summary: 你容易因為新機會而搬動，但每到一處，都要安排成自己的樣子。
watch: 要留意的是：你被漂亮的地方吸引，也有自己的標準，選擇時別只看門面。
life: 你容易被漂亮的樓盤吸引，也願意花心思佈置成自己要的樣子；買房或租房時多看實際條件，別被裝潢帶著走。

en.summary: New opportunities can easily lead you to move, but wherever you go, you arrange it your own way.
en.watch: The catch: attractive places draw you and you have your own standards, so don't choose on looks alone.
en.life: Handsome developments catch your eye easily, and you're willing to put effort into making a place your own; when buying or renting, look harder at the practical conditions and don't be carried along by the decor.

summary: 你要有事可做才安心，但每天仍需要一段獨處，把心裡的東西放下。
watch: 要留意的是：你習慣忙著照顧別人，最容易擠掉的，正是自己獨處的時間。
life: 空閒時你寧願幫人、辦活動，也不想閒著；只是一天下來，要留一段一個人看書、散步的時間，才放得下收起來的情緒。

en.summary: You need something to do to feel at ease, yet every day you still need some time alone to set down what's on your mind.
en.watch: The catch: you're used to keeping busy looking after others, and the first thing to get squeezed out is your own time alone.
en.life: In your free time you'd rather help people or organise something than sit idle; but at the end of the day, keep some time to read or walk alone, so you can let go of the feelings you've been holding.

summary: 你對長輩和上司多半順著來，但涉及原則時，你不會讓步。
watch: 要留意的是：你平時不爭，一到原則問題就很堅持，長輩會覺得你突然變了。
life: 父母或上司安排的小事你多半照做；碰到你認為不對的事，你會講道理到底，平時就先說出自己的界線，摩擦會少一點。

en.summary: With elders and managers you mostly go along, but where principle is involved, you won't give way.
en.watch: The catch: you don't usually argue, but on matters of principle you hold firm, and elders may feel you've suddenly changed.
en.life: You usually go along with small things your parents or manager arrange; when something seems wrong, you'll argue it through, so stating your limits early will mean less friction.

summary: 你對長輩和上司不正面違逆，但講不通的事，你會一直問下去。
watch: 要留意的是：你表面順著來，心裡的疑問卻沒有放下，問得太遲反而像是翻舊帳。
life: 長輩和上司安排的事你多半照做，只是覺得不合理時會追問原因；早一點問、先說明你想把事做好，對方較容易接受。

en.summary: You don't openly defy elders or managers, but when something doesn't make sense, you keep asking.
en.watch: The catch: you go along on the surface without letting your questions go, and asking too late can sound like raking up the past.
en.life: You usually do what elders and managers arrange, but when it seems unreasonable you ask why; asking early, and saying first that you want to get it right, makes it easier for them to accept.

summary: 你和長輩意見不同時多半另找辦法，但原則問題你不會讓步。
watch: 要留意的是：小分歧你繞過去，大分歧你硬起來，長輩不容易預料你會怎樣反應。
life: 和父母或上司意見不同時，你通常另想辦法把事辦成；真正涉及原則的事，你會講到底，先分清哪些值得爭。

en.summary: When you disagree with elders you usually find another way, but on matters of principle you won't give way.
en.watch: The catch: you go around small disagreements and stand firm on big ones, so elders find it hard to predict how you'll react.
en.life: When you disagree with parents or a manager, you usually find another way to get things done; on real matters of principle you'll argue it through, so first sort out which ones are worth the fight.

summary: 你和長輩意見不同時，有時繞路把事辦成，有時會直接問個明白。
watch: 要留意的是：你繞開了的分歧和你追問的分歧，未必是最重要的那幾件。
life: 和父母或上司意見不同，小事你另想辦法辦成，講不通的事你會追問原因；先想清楚哪件最重要，再決定攤開談。

en.summary: When you disagree with elders, sometimes you go around and get it done, and sometimes you ask outright.
en.watch: The catch: the disagreements you sidestep and the ones you press on aren't necessarily the ones that matter most.
en.life: When you disagree with parents or a manager, you find another way on small things and ask why on things that don't make sense; work out first which matters most, then decide what to talk through openly.

summary: 你對長輩和上司有時直說，有時把不同意見收在心裡。
watch: 要留意的是：你說了多少、收起多少，對方未必察覺，真正的距離容易被忽略。
life: 上司或長輩交代的事，你認同就全力去做；心裡不同意時你未必當面說，偶爾找個私下的機會說出來。

en.summary: With elders and managers you sometimes speak plainly and sometimes keep your disagreement to yourself.
en.watch: The catch: they may not notice how much you've said and how much you've held back, so the real distance is easily missed.
en.life: When a manager or elder asks something of you, you give it your all if you agree; when you disagree you may not say so to their face, so now and then find a private moment to say it.

summary: 你照章辦事，但規則要講得通，你才會真心配合。
watch: 要留意的是：講不通時你多半自己消化，不說出來，關係表面平順，心裡卻僵著。
life: 你在機構裡把流程處理得穩妥，前提是你認同那些規定；遇到講不通的規定，先了解原因，必要時說出來，比自己消化好。

en.summary: You go by the book, but the rules have to make sense before you truly cooperate.
en.watch: The catch: when they don't, you mostly swallow it without saying so, and the relationship looks smooth while you stay stiff inside.
en.life: In an organisation you handle procedures soundly, provided you agree with the rules; when a rule doesn't make sense, find out why first and speak up if needed, rather than swallowing it.

summary: 你要規則說得通才服，說不通時不硬碰，而是另找空隙把事做成。
watch: 要留意的是：你先做後說，長輩和上司往往最後一個知道你其實不同意。
life: 認同的規定你守得很嚴；不認同時你不會正面頂撞，而是找空隙做想做的事；重要的事先打個招呼，可以省下日後的誤會。

en.summary: You need rules to make sense, and when they don't, you don't fight them head-on but find a gap to get things done.
en.watch: The catch: you act first and explain later, so elders and managers are often the last to learn you disagreed.
en.life: Rules you agree with you keep strictly; when you don't, you won't confront them but find a gap to do what you want, and a word in advance on important things saves misunderstandings later.

summary: 你照章辦事，但認為不對時，還是會直接說出來。
watch: 要留意的是：你平時把分歧自己消化，一說出口卻很直，對方會覺得來得突然。
life: 你在大機構裡做得穩妥，文件流程都處理得好；和上司意見不同時，你可能先忍著，忍不住才直說，不如早一點用平和的方式提出。

en.summary: You go by the book, but when you think something is wrong, you still say so directly.
en.watch: The catch: you usually keep disagreements to yourself, but when you do speak it's very direct, and it can feel sudden to the other person.
en.life: You do solid work in large organisations and handle paperwork well; when you disagree with a manager you may hold it in until you can't, so raise it earlier and calmly instead.

summary: 你對長輩和上司直來直往，但有時不爭，直接找空隙把事做成。
watch: 要留意的是：你有時當面頂，有時先做後說，長輩不容易知道你的立場。
life: 覺得不對時你會直說，但也常先把想做的事做成再報告；重要的事先打個招呼，比事後解釋省力。

en.summary: With elders and managers you're direct, though sometimes you don't argue and simply find a gap to get things done.
en.watch: The catch: sometimes you push back to their face, and sometimes you act first and explain later, so elders find it hard to know where you stand.
en.life: When something seems wrong you say so, but you also often get done what you want first and report afterwards; a word in advance on important things takes less effort than explaining later.
